svg.aria-label: fyajan.com — A bearing that finds the right knowledge — the design this profile borrows. The agency's site in the Seyir design: a gyro-compass bridge, eight stations, a free seven-chapter AI course in four languages, the FY assistant with voice, a language academy and a ten-step station that sets up your own assistant. No framework, no tracking.
